title: Null control: Bandar Abbas temp -> DAL
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Bandar Abbas mean temperature 20d z-score > 1 has no predictive link to airline returns (null control, 0 sign); trade long DAL 5d at 2d lag [weather.bandar_abbas.temp_mean -> finance.DAL.log_return]
message: Null control held: Bandar Abbas temp z>1 -> DAL r=0.03 (n=387), 27 trades, hit 37%, excess -0.74%, actionability 1.87 - story not a rule

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.bandar_abbas.temp_mean rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long DAL next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 5 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
